feature_docs.parcel_transaction_count: How many transactions the parcel has in total.
feature_docs.seller_transaction_count: How many transactions this seller appears in (as seller).
feature_docs.buyer_transaction_count: How many transactions this buyer appears in (as buyer).
feature_docs.transaction_frequency: Parcel transactions per year of its recorded history.
feature_docs.days_since_previous_transfer: Days since the previous transfer of the parcel (20000 if first).
feature_docs.has_previous_transfer: 1 if the parcel had an earlier transfer.
feature_docs.average_transfer_interval: Average days between transfers of this parcel.
feature_docs.seller_share_before: Seller's recorded share (%) before the transfer.
feature_docs.share_ratio: Transferred share / seller share before (capped at 5).
feature_docs.ownership_sequence: Position of the transaction in the parcel's ownership sequence.
feature_docs.ownership_change_count: Number of ownership changes on the parcel up to and including this one.
feature_docs.seller_prior_txns_on_parcel: Earlier transactions by the same seller on the same parcel.
feature_docs.seller_prior_share_sold: Cumulative share (%) the seller already sold on this parcel earlier.
feature_docs.registration_delay_days: Days between transaction and registration (negative = registered before).
feature_docs.type_Sale: 1 if the transaction type is Sale.
feature_docs.type_Gift: 1 if the transaction type is Gift.
feature_docs.type_Inheritance: 1 if the transaction type is Inheritance.
feature_docs.type_Transfer: 1 if the transaction type is Transfer.
feature_docs.type_Partition: 1 if the transaction type is Partition.
feature_docs.status_Completed: 1 if the transaction status is Completed.
feature_docs.status_Pending: 1 if the transaction status is Pending.
feature_docs.status_Cancelled: 1 if the transaction status is Cancelled.
feature_docs.status_Under Review: 1 if the transaction status is Under Review.
feature_docs.registration_buyer_match: 1 buyer in registration equals transaction buyer, 0 differs, -1 no registration.
feature_docs.registration_seller_match: 1 seller in registration equals transaction seller, 0 differs, -1 no registration.
feature_docs.registration_area_diff: Absolute area difference registration vs transaction (-1 if missing).
feature_docs.registration_type_match: 1 registration type equals transaction type, 0 differs, -1 missing.
feature_docs.mutation_owner_match: 1 mutation owner equals registered buyer, 0 differs, -1 no mutation.
feature_docs.mutation_previous_match: 1 mutation previous owner equals registered seller, 0 differs, -1 no mutation.
feature_docs.mutation_area_diff: Absolute area difference mutation vs registration (-1 if missing).
feature_docs.mutation_share_diff: Absolute share difference mutation vs transaction (-1 if missing).
feature_docs.mutation_type_match: 1 mutation type equals registration type, 0 differs, -1 missing.
feature_docs.ownership_chain_consistent: 1 recorded seller equals recorded previous owner, else 0.
feature_docs.reg_minus_txn_days: Registration date minus transaction date in days (0 if missing).
feature_docs.mut_minus_reg_days: Mutation date minus registration date in days (0 if missing).

notes: fraud_labels.csv is synthetic ground truth derived from deterministic rules over the same records.
'pattern' = raw history/timing features only; 'records' adds record-comparison features; 'full' adds the rule signals and is shown only to demonstrate label leakage.
Stored ML scores are 5-fold out-of-fold predictions, so no transaction is scored by a model that saw its label.
The Investigation Priority Score is NOT a fraud probability.
